name: Aetherial Clockwork Garden
description: Floating islands drift in a pastel sky, each hosting intricate clockwork flora that ticks in harmony with the wind.
prompt: A surreal sky garden: several levitating islands covered in brass and copper clockwork plants — gear-driven vines, piston blossoms, ticking leaf mechanisms. Soft pastel clouds, golden hour light, gentle motion blur on moving gears. Steampunk aesthetic, ultra-sharp, 8K.
caption: Time blossoms in brass and wind. ⚙️🌿 #AetherialClockworkGarden
